children: Philippine exports climbed by 27.8% year-on-year to USD 9.1 billion in August 2026, marking the strongest growth since April 2024 and accelerating from a slightly upwardly revised 10.9% increase in the previous month.

Electronic products remained the top export commodity, accounting for 68.1% of total shipments and rising 59.9%, led by semiconductor components (+73.5%),  office equipment (+73.3%), and consumer electronics (+111.4%).
Outbound sales also increased for gold (+15%) and bananas (+7%).
In contrast, exports declined for other manufactured goods (-14.4%) and machinery and transport equipment (-26%).
Among major trading partners, exports to the US, the largest market accounting for 23.8% of total shipments, surged by 94.6%.
Shipments also increased from Hong Kong (+30.5%), China (+22.9%), Taiwan (+76.5%), and Singapore (+69.2%).
Considering the first eight months of the year, total exports grew by 14.8% to USD 64 billion.

title: Philippine Exports Growth Hits Over 2-Year High
